title: Thousands in Portugal protest against surging rental prices
html:
Thousands in Portugal protest against surging rental prices

Thousands of people across Portugal are angry about rising rental prices, demanding the government take action to end the housing crisis. Authorities have begun implementing changes aimed at lowering prices, but protesters tell Al Jazeera’s Rosie Birchard more must be done.
summary: Thousands of people across Portugal are angry about rising rental prices, demanding action to end the housing crisis.
